texto: **Tant de** + noun + **que** = so much... that: **Il y a tant de boue que nous rentrons à pied** (there is so much mud that we go back on foot).
**Si bien que** (so that) introduces the consequence: **Il a beaucoup plu, si bien que la route est fermée** (has rained a lot, so the road is closed).

One consequence found is indicative: **Il a plu, si bien que la route est fermée**. **De sorte que** can also express a wanted purpose; in that case it carries subjunctive: **Je parle lentement de sorte que chacun puisse comprendre** (I speak slowly so that everyone can understand).

filas: Il a beaucoup plu, si bien que la route est fermée.
Il y a tant de boue que nous rentrons à pied.
Il parle lentement de sorte que chacun puisse comprendre.

frases.fr: Il a beaucoup plu, si bien que la route est fermée.
frases.es: Ha llovido mucho, de modo que la carretera está cerrada.
frases.en: It's rained a lot, so the road's closed.

frases.fr: Il y a tant de boue que nous rentrons à pied.
frases.es: Hay tanto barro que volvemos a casa a pie.
frases.en: There's so much mud we're going home on foot.
analisis: so much mud that (quantity intensifier + consequence)

frases.fr: Puisque la route est fermée, je reste ici.
frases.es: Puesto que la carretera está cerrada, me quedo aquí.
frases.en: Since the road is closed, I'm staying here.

frases.fr: Vu que tu restes, je reste aussi.
frases.es: Visto que te quedas, me quedo también.
frases.en: Since you're staying, I'm staying too.

bloques.pregunta: What way does it go after «si bien que» (real consequence)?

opciones.explicacion: The real consequence goes with an indication.

bloques.pregunta: What does «il y a tant de boue que» mean?

bloques.frase: Il a beaucoup plu, ___ la route est fermée.
Il y a ___ boue que nous rentrons à pied.

opciones.explicacion: It does not go with «que» of consequence.
That's not the use of this phrase.

bloques.frase: Puisque la route est fermée, je reste ici.

opciones.texto: Since the road is closed, I'm staying here.
Although the road is closed, I'm staying here.
For the road to be closed, I'm staying here.

bloques.audio: Vu que tu restes, je reste aussi.

opciones.texto: Since you're staying, I'm staying too.
Without you staying, I'm staying too.

bloques.pregunta: What formal connector expresses a logical consequence equivalent to «por consiguiente»?

opciones.explicacion: «Par conséquent» introduces a direct consequence into a formal or careful record.
«Puisque» introduces a known cause («since»), not a consequence.

frases.fr: Il a plu pendant plusieurs semaines, si bien que les chemins sont devenus difficiles.
frases.es: Llovió durante varias semanas, de modo que los caminos se volvieron difíciles.
frases.en: It rained for several weeks, so the roads became difficult.

frases.fr: La récolte a diminué ; par conséquent, certains produits coûtent plus cher.
frases.es: La cosecha disminuyó; por consiguiente, algunos productos cuestan más.
frases.en: The harvest decreased; therefore, some products cost more.

frases.fr: En raison de cette hausse, plusieurs familles achètent local.
frases.es: Debido a esta subida, varias familias compran productos locales.
frases.en: Because of this rise, several families buy local products.

frases.fr: Les producteurs espèrent que le temps s'améliorera bientôt.
frases.es: Los productores esperan que el tiempo mejore pronto.
frases.en: The producers expect time to improve soon.
analisis: that time will improve (the future of the sign rules)

bloques.pregunta: Why do some products cost more?

opciones.explicacion: The text links the decrease with the price increase.
This decision is a result of the increase.
The text says they expect it to improve.

opciones.texto: Let the weather get better soon.

opciones.explicacion: They're said to have become difficult, not close.

intro: Today we are talking about consequences: when something happens so much that it causes something else.
